<MethodEndpoint

Account-level, with no project in the path (RN-611): the one-line install creates a machine key before any project exists, and every other listing is per project. Returns ONLY machine keys (`especie: "maquina"`, `projectId: null`) and ONLY the caller’s — project keys stay in their project’s listing, and no one sees another user’s keys (RN-519). Revoked keys are INCLUDED: registering a new machine key revokes the previous one (RN-552), and this list is where that shows. `lastUsedAt` is a recorded use, never a live connection; null means the key was never used.
